meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文章、笔记或选题变成无出镜的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有现成文字,想把它做成无人出镜的解说视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with invented scene visuals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have existing text and want it turned into a faceless explainer video.

howto.what: 把文章、笔记或一个主题变成无实拍画面的解说视频:没有素材可拍,画面按场景现场发明(排版、图示、数据图)。先出分镜与脚本,再逐帧搭建,最后导出 mp4。
howto.when: 当你要做主题讲解、概念拆解或操作教程等类型的视频时接管;它不做基于网站的宣传片,意图不明时先走 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: Turns an article, notes, or a topic into a faceless explainer video: nothing is captured, so each scene's visuals are invented (typography, graphics, diagrams). It plans a storyboard and script, builds the frames, then renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a topic explainer, concept breakdown, or how-to from text; it does not build videos from a website. Unclear intent goes through /hyperframes first.
